description: This file contains unit tests for the MqttContext class within the MQTT adapter module, verifying tenant extraction, property bag parsing, endpoint expansion, and factory methods.

classes.name: MqttContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for MqttContext, testing tenant extraction, property parsing, endpoint expansion, and factory behaviors.

methods.name: testTenantIsRetrievedFromAuthenticatedDevice
methods.description: Tests that the tenant is correctly retrieved from an authenticated device message.

methods.name: testTenantIsRetrievedFromTopic
methods.description: Tests tenant retrieval from message topic when device is not authenticated.

methods.name: verifyPropertyBagRetrievedFromTopic
methods.description: Validates that the property bag is correctly parsed from the message topic's query parameters.

methods.name: testFactoryMethodExpandsShortNames
methods.description: Checks that short endpoint names are expanded properly to full endpoint types.

methods.name: assertEndpoint
methods.description: Helper method that asserts that a given message corresponds to the expected endpoint type.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a mock MqttPublishMessage with a specific topic formatted for tests.
